Image2 original portrait is identity reference, Image3 PRIMARY STYLE reference: clean bright rounded painted Daoist Q game art. Native at least 1024x1024 square, transparent RGBA. Entire body/bow in frame, no shadows/text/extra objects. Two arms/two legs. Anatomical LEFT hand holds bow, right arm free. Do not leave neutral standing legs; make new articulated pose: NORTHEAST back-right diagonal camera identical. Almost passing: screen RIGHT supporting boot flat nearly under hip; SCREEN LEFT bent knee swings forward so raised boot approaches the right supporting ankle, just behind and lower-left, heel lifted and sole partly visible. Narrower separation than early contact, natural walking not sprinting. Two feet, right supports.
